why: From A to B the figure becomes bigger and is flipped top to bottom (the slanted line now goes the other way). So C must also become bigger and flip top to bottom: its two dots move to the bottom and the single dot goes to the top. Option 1 shows this. Option 2 is bigger but not flipped, and option 4 is lying sideways.
trick: Two changes can happen together: size and flip. Check both before you choose.
note: In the scan option 1 and option 5 look almost the same (one dot on top, two at the bottom); option 5 is drawn a little narrower and taller, option 1 is the exact flipped, enlarged C. Book answer is 1.
